verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider with client-facing workflows and status dashboards, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes an AI assistant to which users can delegate tasks. The 'agent' in docs-14 is a visa petitioning agent, not an AI agent, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
